name: remem-grokbot
description: Grok Bot Remem connector. Ten house remem_* tools over stdio python3 against https://api.remem.io. Writes stay in namespace grokbot.

REMEM_API_KEY.title: Remem API key
REMEM_API_KEY.description: Remem data-plane API key (vlt_...). Plugin setup secret. Never commit this value.

REMEM_DEFAULT_NAMESPACE.title: Default write namespace
REMEM_DEFAULT_NAMESPACE.description: Forced write namespace. Must not be default. Connector injects grokbot when unset or default.
